content.summary: Bank of New York Mellon recently launched the BNY Dreyfus StablecoinReserves Fund, a money market fund aimed at supporting institutional adoption of digital assets in response to the passage of the GENIUS Act, which sets regulatory standards for U.S. stablecoin issuers. The fund, which does not invest in stablecoins but provides eligible reserve solutions, has already secured initial backing from Anchorage Digital, highlighting growing collaboration between traditional financial institutions...
